items.title: A proper space finite locally free over a dense open becomes finite locally free after an admissible blow-up
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For B quasi-compact quasi-separated, U a quasi-compact open, f : X -> B proper with f^{-1}(U) -> U finite locally free, the lemma produces a U-admissible blow-up B' -> B such that the strict transform X' of X is finite locally free over B'. The retained proof is written: the chapter's flat-after-blowing-up theorem (cited by name) replaces f by a flat finitely presented strict transform; another U-admissible blow-up makes U scheme-theoretically dense in B (standard reduction cited inside the flat-after sequence); the chapter's proper-flat-finite-over-dense-open lemma (collected last wave as L16101) then promotes f to finite; finally finite plus flat of finite presentation is finite locally free (Morphisms of Spaces, lemma finite-flat). Retained author proof at lines 8926-8934.
